name: Is it better to repair the floor or replace the whole thing in a mobile home?
description: Repair is usually better for small, contained damage. Replacement makes more sense when rot is widespread or the floor system has failed in more than one area.

mainEntity.name: Is it better to repair the floor or replace the whole thing in a mobile home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When comparing repair options, look at whether the company checks for underlying water damage, replaces subfloor correctly, and explains what is and is not included. A lower quote is not always better if it only covers surface materials and skips structural repair.
